Subject: Order Form: Security Exhibit — evidence orbit kickoff & pen-test window

Hi Tim / AlderBio team,

Thanks for progressing the order form review — appreciate the quick turnaround on the commercial side. Before we push the redlines back to your legal/procurement queue, wanted to run a short kickoff on the security exhibit items we expect to land in the MSA/order form (SOC 2 artifacts, pen-test language, evidence cadence).

High-level propose:
- Share a consolidated draft of the security exhibit (attached) that maps SOC 2 artifact ownership and a recommended evidence cadence (monthly artifact bundle + quarterly samples).
- Suggest a pen-test window in Q1 2027 (targeting a 2-week notice period and a 3-day staging access window) — scope sheet attached as an editable workbook.
- Ask AlderBio to confirm whether a single pen-test vendor is preferred (you supply the vendor) or if Redwood should authorize a scoped vendor under an NDA.

Open questions for sync:
1) Is AlderBio comfortable with a monthly evidence bundle and quarterly sample checks, or do you need a different tempo for procurement/compliance?
2) Any mandatory carveouts we should reflect (e.g., PII-only sampling, no production-only live tests)?
3) Doc signing workflow: do you prefer DocuSign per-order or a master Order Form addendum?

If that makes sense, I'd like to propose a 30-minute call tomorrow 11/30 at 10:00am PT to walk the draft and capture redlines live. If you prefer, we can also route an annotated PDF for legal markup.

Attaching: security-exhibit-draft-v2.pdf (redlines expected) and pen-test-scope.xlsx (editable). Google Drive link in related links.

Thanks — Rafael
Rafael Mendes

Subject: Re: Order Form: Security Exhibit — evidence orbit kickoff & pen-test window

Thanks Rafa / Tim — quick clarifications from an operations / SOC 2 standpoint so we align the redline language: 

- SOC 2 artifacts: we'll provide a monthly bundle that includes the latest SOC 2 Type II report (when in-scope), system configuration inventory, and a scoped list of logging/monitoring extracts. For sample evidence we recommend immutable snapshots for 90-day retention windows.

- Pen-test language we prefer in the exhibit: a) 30-days notice to schedule (for production-impacting tests), b) a defined staging environment with ephemeral credentials, c) a vulnerability triage SLA (48 hours for critical, 7 days for high). The attached pen-test-scope.xlsx contains suggested wording blocks you can copy into the exhibit.

- Evidence cadence: propose monthly drop + quarterly sampled deep-dive (sample size ~5% of production systems or an agreed list). If AlderBio requires more frequent slices (e.g., weekly extracts), note that as an uplift in the order form (we can quantify).

A couple of redline suggestions to preempt back-and-forth with your legal team:
1) Replace broad "inspection rights" language with bounded inspection windows and data-access scoping (to avoid open-ended forensic access requests).
2) Limit tenant-level data export rights to agreed assertion buckets in the exhibit (SOC 2 control mappings) and require a subpoena or court order for any raw customer data exports outside the exhibit.

If Tim is good with a 10:00am PT slot tomorrow we can run through these sections and capture live notes for legal.

Monica Patel
Director, Assurance & Compliance
Redwood Inference

Rafael / Monica — thanks for the clear summary and attachments. AlderBio is targeting an internal compliance review next week and the 10:00am PT slot tomorrow works for me (I can do 10:15 if that helps). A few notes from procurement side: 

- Monthly evidence bundle is fine, but procurement will ask to see sample artifact names in the exhibit (please list file-level artifacts).
- For pen-tests, AlderBio prefers to nominate the vendor; we'll share a panel of approved vendors and coordinate. We do expect a 14-day notice for production-impacting tests, so if Redwood prefers 30-day notice for scheduling that's okay, procurement will ask for an exception flow if an emergency scoping is needed.
- DocuSign: prefer per-order DocuSign for the first 12 months, then evaluate master-addendum.

I confirmed the team will look at the exhibit PDF and markup. We should have initial legal comments by EOD 12/3. I'll be on the call tomorrow at 10:15am PT.

—Tim

B) Contractual Exhibit — stronger legal hooks (audit rights spelled out and order form uplift if AlderBio requires more frequent artifacts).
